# Compile Run Schema Definition

This feature defines the schema for CompileRun in the data model, capturing details about the compilation process, including the repository it belongs to, its status, and timestamps. This facilitates tracking the state and history of compilation runs.

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.CompileRun`
